name: Observability Health Dashboard v10
description: CMDB apps via cmdb_businessapp + host dt.cost.product join; Commander/Powderkeg pending lookup rows enriched inline.

0.content:
# Observability Health Dashboard v10

CMDB apps (`/lookups/cmdb_businessapp`) joined to OneAgent hosts via tag **`dt.cost.product`** = `application_id`.

**Pending lookup rows:** Home Commander (`7654`), Powderkeg Web (`jira`) — enriched inline until CMDB Sync adds them.

**Automation:** CMDB Sync workflows + host product tags.

1.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields tags
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name}
| fieldsAdd `Application` = coalesce(application_name, if(application_id == "7654", then:"Home Commander", else:if(application_id == "jira", then:"Powderkeg Web", else:concat("Unmapped:", application_id))))
| summarize `Total Applications` = countDistinct(`Application`)
1.title: Total Applications

2.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields id, name
| summarize `Monitored Hosts` = count()
2.title: Monitored Hosts

3.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields tags
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name}
| fieldsAdd mapped = isNotNull(application_name)
| summarize total = count(), mapped = countIf(mapped)
| fieldsAdd `Coverage %` = round(100.0 * mapped / total)
| fields `Coverage %`
3.title: CMDB Tag Coverage %

4.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields name, tags
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name}
| filter isNull(application_name)
| summarize `Unmapped Hosts` = count()
4.title: Unmapped Hosts

5.content:
## Application inventory
Hosts rolled up by CMDB application (inline pending for Commander / Powderkeg).

6.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields id, name, tags
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name, cmdb_owner, tier}
| fieldsAdd `Application` = coalesce(application_name, if(application_id == "7654", then:"Home Commander", else:if(application_id == "jira", then:"Powderkeg Web", else:concat("Unmapped:", application_id))))
| fieldsAdd cmdb_owner = coalesce(cmdb_owner, "John"), tier = coalesce(tier, "?")
| fieldsAdd `In Lookup` = if(isNotNull(application_name), then:"Yes", else:if(application_id == "7654" OR application_id == "jira", then:"Pending", else:"No"))
| summarize `Hosts` = count(), by:{application_id, `Application`, cmdb_owner, tier, `In Lookup`}
| fields `Application`, tier, Owner = cmdb_owner, `Product ID` = application_id, `Hosts`, `In Lookup`
| sort `Application` asc
6.title: Application Inventory

8.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields id, name, tags
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name, cmdb_owner, tier}
| fieldsAdd `Application` = coalesce(application_name, if(application_id == "7654", then:"Home Commander", else:if(application_id == "jira", then:"Powderkeg Web", else:concat("Unmapped:", application_id))))
| fieldsAdd cmdb_owner = coalesce(cmdb_owner, "John"), tier = coalesce(tier, "?")
| fieldsAdd `In Lookup` = if(isNotNull(application_name), then:"Yes", else:if(application_id == "7654" OR application_id == "jira", then:"Pending", else:"No"))
| fields Host = name, `Application`, `Product ID` = application_id, Owner = cmdb_owner, tier, `In Lookup`
| sort `Application` asc, Host asc
8.title: Hosts by Application

10.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields id, name, tags
| fieldsAdd host_id = id
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name, cmdb_owner, tier}
| fieldsAdd `Application` = coalesce(application_name, if(application_id == "7654", then:"Home Commander", else:if(application_id == "jira", then:"Powderkeg Web", else:concat("Unmapped:", application_id))))
| fieldsAdd cmdb_owner = coalesce(cmdb_owner, "John"), tier = coalesce(tier, "?")
| fieldsAdd `In Lookup` = if(isNotNull(application_name), then:"Yes", else:if(application_id == "7654" OR application_id == "jira", then:"Pending", else:"No"))
| lookup [
  fetch events
  | filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND event.status == "ACTIVE"
  | expand affected_entity_id = affected_entity_ids
  | filter startsWith(affected_entity_id, "HOST-")
  | summarize active_problems = countDistinct(event.id), by:{host_id = affected_entity_id}
], sourceField:host_id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{active_problems}
| fieldsAdd active_problems = coalesce(active_problems, 0)
| summarize `Active Problems` = sum(active_problems), by:{`Application`}
| filter `Active Problems` > 0
| sort `Active Problems` desc
10.title: Active Problems by Application

11.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields id, name, tags
| fieldsAdd host_id = id
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name, cmdb_owner, tier}
| fieldsAdd `Application` = coalesce(application_name, if(application_id == "7654", then:"Home Commander", else:if(application_id == "jira", then:"Powderkeg Web", else:concat("Unmapped:", application_id))))
| fieldsAdd cmdb_owner = coalesce(cmdb_owner, "John"), tier = coalesce(tier, "?")
| fieldsAdd `In Lookup` = if(isNotNull(application_name), then:"Yes", else:if(application_id == "7654" OR application_id == "jira", then:"Pending", else:"No"))
| lookup [
  fetch events
  | filter event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM"
  | expand affected_entity_id = affected_entity_ids
  | filter startsWith(affected_entity_id, "HOST-")
  | summarize total_problems = countDistinct(event.id), by:{host_id = affected_entity_id}
], sourceField:host_id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{total_problems}
| fieldsAdd total_problems = coalesce(total_problems, 0)
| summarize `Total Problems` = sum(total_problems), by:{`Application`}
| filter `Total Problems` > 0
| sort `Total Problems` desc
11.title: Problems (dashboard timeframe) by Application

13.query:
smartscapeNodes HOST
| fields id, name, tags, installerVersion
| fieldsAdd application_id = toString(tags[`dt.cost.product`])
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:application_id, lookupField:application_id, fields:{application_name, cmdb_owner, tier}
| fieldsAdd `Application` = coalesce(application_name, if(application_id == "7654", then:"Home Commander", else:if(application_id == "jira", then:"Powderkeg Web", else:concat("Unmapped:", application_id))))
| fieldsAdd cmdb_owner = coalesce(cmdb_owner, "John"), tier = coalesce(tier, "?")
| fieldsAdd `In Lookup` = if(isNotNull(application_name), then:"Yes", else:if(application_id == "7654" OR application_id == "jira", then:"Pending", else:"No"))
| fields Host = name, `Application`, `OneAgent Version` = coalesce(installerVersion, "Unknown")
| sort `Application` asc, Host asc
13.title: OneAgent Deployment by Application
